notes: Facts confirmed 2026-09-10 from the church's own site. Address is 404 S. Columbus Blvd., Tucson AZ 85711 (from the site's contact block, phone 520-326-1366); Sunday worship 10:45am. PASTORS: the 'Meet Our Leaders' page lists staff as married couples, so the entries read 'Curtis & Sabrina Burch - Senior Pastor & Celebrate Recovery Director' and 'Dave & Kathi Schone - Associate Pastor'. Recorded here as Curtis Burch (Senior Pastor) and Dave Schone (Associate Pastor); the page does not say which spouse holds which title, so if Sabrina Burch or Kathi Schone turns out to preach, add them separately rather than assuming. Sermon media: YouTube @tucsoncentralchurch4860 ('Services and Sermons from Tucson Central Church of the Nazarene'), plus the site's own /sermons/ index. Caveat on the speakers index: it currently returns only one speaker entry (Curtis & Sabrina Burch, most recent item dated 10 March 2024), so it may be stale or only partially populated - verify against the YouTube uploads before relying on it for per-preacher attribution. Coordinates still need tools/geocode.py.
